entities.name: Jewish cemetery in Oświęcim
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Jewish cemetery in Oświęcim, Poland, was destroyed by the Germans during World War II and partly restored by returning Jewish survivors after the Holocaust. In Communist Poland it fell into disrepair and was fully restored in the 1990s.
